brief:
Pro-Palestine demonstrators marched on the Labour Party's annual conference in Liverpool, according to Al Jazeera English. The protesters called for an end to arms supplies to Israel as the party gathered for its yearly meeting.

The demonstration reflects ongoing pressure within Britain's political landscape over weapons transfers and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with activists targeting one of the country's major political institutions during a high-profile gathering.
dek: Pro-Palestine protesters have marched on Labour’s annual conference in Liverpool.
title: Pro-Palestine protesters march on Labour conference demanding arms halt
